title: Download selected authorized supplier purchase exposure page as PDF
description: A purchasing user downloads the selected bounded supplier exposure page as a paginated Chinese PDF with PDFsharp and shared SimHei resolver. Development only. Reuse ERP-031 SupplierPurchaseExposure.ForQueryAsync, its supplier/currency/date/link-status filters and bounded page; recheck the current user's purchase-order menu for every request, fail closed on missing permission and invalid filters, and use existing HTTP operation audit. Keep linked settlement evidence separate from ambiguous/unavailable references, preserve null unknown amounts and original currencies, and state this is not accounts payable or payment authority. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses ERP-148 authorized bounded preview and rechecks current-user menu, filters and fields before any bytes.
PDF renders chosen order fields, Chinese labels, separate currencies and explicit unknown or ambiguous link evidence across row and column pages without clipping; missing SimHei fails visibly.
Designer offers PDF with visible empty/authorization/font failures; tests inspect signature, selected order, page bounds, unknown evidence, font failure and no writes; document font prerequisite.
